concept: Multi-AZ: ASG behind ALB against AZ failure
tests: Choosing the canonical architecture that keeps a web app available when an entire AZ fails.
expected: Auto Scaling Group (min 2) across two AZs behind an Application Load Balancer — healthy capacity in the surviving AZ, failed instances auto-replaced. Triggers: "available if an entire Availability Zone fails".
why_not: A single instance (with an EIP or snapshot policy) is a single point of failure; a cluster placement group keeps everything in one AZ.
